Hi all,

Thanks for your interest in a short group walkthrough of Redwood Inference focusing on multi-tenant inference patterns and cost-saving knobs (KV cache, batching, quantization). We commonly run a compact 40-minute session (20-min demo, 15-min Q&A, 5-min next steps).

We have a few prospects who indicated the same interest and want to consolidate into one cohort session to reduce duplicate content. Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 24 — 10:00am or 5:30pm
- Wed Nov 25 — 11:00am or 6:30pm

If you could reply with preferred slot(s) and timezone, we’ll finalize and send a single calendar invite with an ICS bundle so each company can add the correct timezone instance to their calendar. Attaching a short agenda and an ICS bundle stub for review.

Attachments: group-demo-agenda.pdf, ics-bundle.zip

Quick asks: 1) preferred date/time; 2) whether you need an NDA/POC mention up front; 3) any specific area you want covered (routing, dedicated capacity, or private deployments).

Thanks — looking forward to hosting.

—
